sara: Heads-up — EU change window tomorrow 00:30-01:30 UTC. Need final pin list and rollback owners by EOD today.

mike: putting together pin matrix now. will post in ~30m. who owns DB migration rollback?

raj: I can own migration rollback. plan: migration runs in canary mode first (10% traffic), smoke checks then full roll.

olivia: Deploy checklist (quick):
• confirm model pins in deploybot config
• enable canary routing (10/50/100)
• smoke tests + latency SLOs checked
• cost cap on embeddings turned on
• tracing hooks attached

olivia: copying as code block so deploybot can pick it up:```
PIN_MATRIX: feature-api=v3.4.2, reranker=v2.1.0
CANARY_STEPS: 10,50,100
SMOKE_SCRIPT: ./infra/smoke/e2e_canary.sh
ROLLBACK_OWNER: raj
```

deploy-bot: @sara deploy-plan received. Will create canary pipeline when pin config is updated. Reply with `deploy-bot confirm` to kick off manual canary.

sara: @deploy-bot confirm — but hold at 10% until ops-oncall signs off on infra metrics.

ops-oncall: I will monitor infra. Quick checklist from my side:
- GPU mem pressure < 70%
- RPC error rate < 0.5%
- tail latency P99 < 300ms
- prefix cache hitrate > 25%
If any breach, I will trigger emergency unpin.

mike: pin matrix posted to the runbook. also added release notes draft: short summary, breaking changes, rollback steps, who to page.

raj: canary smoke script includes these checks: health endpoints, sample-generation QA, kv-cache warmup, metric thresholds. If QA fails, run `./infra/scripts/rollback_migration.sh` and revert pins.

olivia: small ask — add a rate-limit bump window for traffic warmup (5m ramp). avoids throttle storms.

sara: agreed. add to runbook and to the deploybot manual step. Also adding a post-deploy verification window: 30m quiet period for client-facing SDKs.

mike: tagging product-alerts and support on the release notes. will push PR for release notes now.

ops-oncall: I'll be on standby + pager during the 00:30-01:30 UTC window and for 30m after. If anything odd, ping #eng-oncall as well.

raj: last check — who owns the fallback model plan if dedicated capacity hits limit? we have a smaller quantized variant ready (reranker-q).

olivia: reranker-q is the fallback. deploybot has fallback routing policy set to `policy=fallback:rq1` in the pipeline. documented in the runbook.

sara: Perfect. Final list we have: pins (mike), migration rollback (raj), infra watch (ops-oncall), release notes (mike), deploy trigger (sara). Everyone good? :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup:

raj: :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled manual canary window for 2964512399 on request. Remember to post final pin PR link in this thread.
